title: Acamprosate for alcohol use disorder: ClinicalTrials.gov posted results only
intro: Randomized trials of acamprosate against placebo with a posted drinking outcome after at least 4 weeks of treatment, from query.cond=alcohol&query.intr=acamprosate, filter AREA[HasResults]true (11 records, 2026-10-15). Inclusion, outcome rule and the general/comorbid classification were committed before any outcome data were read (aud-comorbidity-prereg-2-2026-10-15.md). Outcome: the posted heavy-drinking measure at end of treatment where posted, otherwise drinks per drinking day or per week, otherwise drinking frequency or abstinence. Dropped on reading: NCT00249379 (control arm got no medication rather than placebo, and posted no data because funding ran out). Excluded from the listing before reading: NCT00106106, NCT04287920, NCT00605904, NCT00656630.
